svg.data-what: a liver lobule: plates of hepatocytes between a central vein and six portal triads

path.data-what: sinusoids: leaky capillaries between the plates, where blood from the portal vein and the artery mixes and flows to the central vein

g.data-what: plates of hepatocytes, the liver cells, one or two cells thick, radiating from the central vein
blood flowing through the sinusoids from the portal triads to the central vein

circle.data-what: the central vein, collecting the blood that has crossed the lobule

g.data-what: portal tracts at the corners of the lobule, each holding a triad: a portal vein branch, a hepatic artery branch and a bile duct
branches of the portal vein, bringing blood from the gut, rich in nutrients
branches of the hepatic artery, bringing oxygen-rich blood
bile ducts, collecting the bile the hepatocytes make, which flows out the opposite way to the blood
bile flowing outward in tiny canals between hepatocytes, toward the bile ducts
